top_signals.title: Bonds Making It Clear the Fed Needs to Hike, Morgan Stanley’s Hornbach Says
top_signals.summary: Matt Hornbach, global head of macro strategy at Morgan Stanley, expects the Federal Reserve to deliver a 25 basis-point rate hike on Wednesday. He says, “it’s certainly a possibility that the Fed is one and done but that’s not what the markets are pricing in at the moment.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Crispin Odey Loses Bid to Overturn UK Financial Services Ban
top_signals.summary: Crispin Odey lost his bid to overturn a lifetime ban from managing money, capping a remarkable fall from grace for the once feted fund manager.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Mortgage rates at five-month high ahead of Bank of England decision
top_signals.summary: Borrowers are bracing for more mortgage woes ahead of the Bank of England’s interest rate decision this week. Mortgage rates have climbed to their highest level in nearly five months after some 25 lenders hiked their deals in the last week including the likes of HSBC, Lloyds and Nationwide.  The average two-year fix has risen [...]
